findings: Ideal four-hole geometry: two equal opposite-transverse pairs gives mu_perp=0, Q21=0, Rz(pi) pair exchange; equal theta,phi gives Q22 proportional 4 sin^2(theta) and fixed-amplitude B(E2) proportional 16 sin^4(theta).
R_y(pi)T preserves xz-plane vectors but is not AMR-exclusive; low-frequency PNC off-diagonal pairing terms prevent unique independent blade decomposition.
Exact identical-fermion g9/2^4 counting gives Jp,max=12, not 18; pairwise classical vector sums cannot bypass Pauli antisymmetry.

Zhang 2019: fixed epsilon2=0.18 misses 104Pd high-frequency B(E2) fall above 0.6 MeV; epsilon2 fitted toward zero near 0.75 MeV; this is an inverse fit, not independent deformation evidence. Predicted four-qp crossing near 0.8 MeV remains model result.
Kumar 2023 review references Pd AMR work in 100-104Pd and odd-A 103/105Pd, but no 106/108Pd AMR entries in its scope. This is a literature-boundary result, not a nonexistence proof.
Rather 2014 first page gives direct 104Pd DSAM scope and semiclassical two-hole formula; complete 5-page experimental table remains unavailable.
